title: Review of Salary and Benefits for Educators and Staff in Mainstream Schools, Preschools and Special Education Schools
what_it_is: Review of Salary and Benefits for Educators and Staff in Mainstream Schools, Preschools and Special Education Schools

sections.label: Salary adjustments for educators
sections.summary: MOE salary adjustments took effect 1 October 2022, while ECDA reviews Early Childhood educator salaries, expected done by end 2022, implemented from 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: MOE recently announced salary adjustments for all eligible Education Officers (EOs), Allied Educators (AEDs) and MOE Kindergarten Educators (MKEs), which took effect on 1 October 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: ECDA is separately conducting a salary review for Early Childhood educators in government-supported preschools to ensure that their salaries are commensurate with their contributions and professional skills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: The salary review is expected to be completed by end 2022 and ECDA will work with government-supported operators to implement the changes from 2023 onwards.

sections.label: Manpower cost funding tranches
sections.summary: Additional funding for manpower costs is provided in two tranches, the first implemented in 2021 and the second planned for 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Additional funding is provided for manpower costs in two tranches – the first has been implemented in 2021 and the second is planned for 2024.

sections.label: Spreading talent across agencies
sections.summary: Within the Public Service, talent is spread across agencies and professional areas, including through the Sun Ray Scheme rotating capable people across agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Within the Public Service, we will spread the talent across different agencies and different professional areas to make sure that all sectors have a fair share of talent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: In fact, one of the schemes that we started many years ago was the Sun Ray Scheme where we develop top talent or capable people and rotate them across agencies to give them exposure beyond the agencies because my personal belief is that we do not develop people within each agency alone in a stovepipe.

sections.label: Remuneration based on skills
sections.summary: In the whole economy, people are encouraged to remunerate based on skills and capabilities, not just credentials.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: In fact, in the whole economy, we are encouraging people to remunerate people based on their skills, capabilities and not just based on their credentials.

sections.label: Factors for remuneration packages
sections.summary: Prior training, contributions in the sector and experiences are factors that help make a remuneration package fair and competitive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: We look at some of the prior training that our people have, the contributions that they are making in the sector and the kind of experiences that they have.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: I think these are all the factors that will help us to make a remuneration package that is both fair and competitive.
